item.title: Cheaper coding models raise the "good enough" bar
item.description: If you're building anything on top of AI models right now, the question of which model does which job just got more concrete. A batch of releases this week made near-frontier coding available at a fraction of the usual price, put a production-grade voice model in developers' hands, and pushed the major assistants toward specific job functions instead of general chat. For teams trying to control inference costs without giving up capability, the tradeoffs are now specific enough to design around.
